_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: Refreshing the model catalog lets a conversation started with no model selected send its preserved draft. The page starts with no models; refreshing the catalog finds the model "predictable". The screen is the default 393x727 phone. To "open the model picker": wait for ".header" to be visible; when the window is narrower than 768px, the picker is in the overflow menu: if ".chat-overflow-popover" is not visible, click the button with aria-label exactly "More options", then click the visible ".model-picker.p-select" inside ".chat-overflow-popover"; on a wider window, click the visible ".model-picker.p-select" inside ".status-bar". The element clicked is "the picker"; its panel is ".model-picker-panel". Call "chat" returns the message and model fields of the chat request the page sent, as JSON ("none" before one). Name elements by ARIA role and accessible name, as Playwright's getByRole does; "named X" means an exact name match. "The input" is data-testid "message-input". Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /new. ".no-models-message" should be visible. 2. Fill the input with "hello": the URL should come to contain "/c/". 3. Open the model picker. Click the panel's button named "Refresh"; the panel's ".model-picker-option-check" should be visible. Click the panel's button named "Close". 4. Click the button named "More options". 5. The input should have the value exactly "hello". 6. Call "chat": it must return "none". Click data-testid "send-button", then call "chat" until it returns {"message":"hello","model":"predictable"}.
